intervals.note: Start is a lower bound: the CERN Courier of 17 August 2000 reports the AD "coming into action for physics" and supplying ATRAP, ATHENA and ASACUSA; the experiment's own first-data date is not stated in a source consulted. End: "While the ATHENA experiment came to an end in 2004, ATRAP is still in operation." (CERN ATRAP page).
intervals.quote: This is the motivation behind CERN’s new AD, which supplies antiprotons to several experiments – ATRAP (son of TRAP at LEAR), ATHENA and ASACUSA.
